{{Quote|I'm finally old enough to go to the Shadow Night Festival. I hope my costume's okay!|Princess Kneesaa, some hours before the party|<ref name="The Raich">{{Ewoks|The Raich}}</ref>}}
The '''Shadow Night Festival''' was a periodic [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] party in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. It was a costumed event in which new Ewok couples danced and got to know one another.

Only adult or teen Ewoks could enjoy the Shadow Night Festival. Generally, male Ewoks would invite their sweethearts.

==Behind the scenes==
The episode "[[The Raich]]" shows the first Shadow Night Festival of the young Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]. Latara accepted Teebo's invitation, after uselessly waiting for other invitations. Wicket and Kneesaa, together since their childhood, went together to the festival. This festival was [[Asha/Legends|Asha's]] first one as well (after her return to the village). She accepted [[Tak (Ewok)|Tak's]] invitation.
